purpose: Explicitly trigger one batched Vercel production deployment after a development session.
source: ChatGPT IFFCO scanned premium sanity hotfix
release_scope: Deploy current main with IFFCO commercial motor parser v2.3. Direct production testing of CVI_N8109328.pdf exposed an unsafe split-row fallback that interpreted table metadata as premiums, producing OD 1 and TP 997134 while insurer/product/policy/IDV/dates were correct. v2.3 rejects SAC code 997134 and implausible premium components, validates split Net(A)/Net(B) pairs against printed net, restricts Owner-Driver CPA extraction to the premium-table row, and falls back to labeled liability rows rather than arbitrary nearby numbers.
verification: The production screenshot is the evidence for the defect: OD 1, TP 997134 and CPA 0 are invalid for the known IFFCO schedule. The v2.3 source change is narrowly scoped to financial candidate validation and CPA row binding. The full repository regression/typecheck/build suite has not been rerun in this session, so the same real policy must be retested after deployment before this financial hotfix is called production-verified.
instructions: Update this file only after the user explicitly requests deployment.
